integrity.computation_scope: 1150 random rooted FMT model compressions, one four-world distinct-witness case and 360 bounded 3-CNF checks; computational evidence is supplemental
integrity.proof_basis: simultaneous finite-subformula induction with one global material counterexample for each root-false implication; polynomial verification and a 3-SAT reduction

scientific_limitations: Requires a universal root and unrestricted formula-indexed implication relations.
The world bound is an upper bound, not a claimed optimal minimum.
NP-completeness is for designated-root semantic satisfiability with each fixed finite Int-valid closed negative axiom set; it does not classify general derivability or arbitrary-world satisfiability.
The original 1992 modal FMT article and detailed version of Tominaga 2026 complexity announcement were not available for full-document originality comparison.
title: Linear witness-star normalization for propositional FMT semantics
